services_heading: Central Heating & Plumbing Services Across Preston
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full system installations, we handle every aspect of domestic heating and plumbing.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Service
services.desc: Fast diagnosis of boiler faults — most jobs completed same day. Annual servicing keeps your system efficient and extends its lifespan.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New boilers and full system upgrades with manufacturer guarantees. We advise on efficiency ratings to reduce your heating bills.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Add new radiators to cold rooms or repair leaking units. We balance systems for even heat distribution throughout your home.

services.title: Emergency Heating Callouts
services.desc: No heat in winter? We respond to breakdowns within hours, any time of day or night, with parts and tools on the van.

services.title: Pipework & Plumbing
services.desc: Leaking pipes, frozen drains, and tap repairs handled quickly. We use modern non-invasive techniques where possible.

services.title: Boiler Replacement
services.desc: Old or inefficient boiler costing you money? We fit modern condensing units with 10-year guarantees and handle all paperwork.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like our own and charge what's fair.
about_para_1: Keighley Plumbing & Heating was established in 2006 by a qualified heating engineer tired of seeing homeowners overcharged for basic repairs. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for honest advice, swift response, and straightforward pricing across Preston and the surrounding areas. Every engineer carries a full toolkit and parts inventory to minimise call-backs.
about_para_2: We specialise in central heating because we know it matters most when it stops working. Our customers trust us because we answer the phone, show up on time, and explain what needs doing before we start work. Many have been with us for over a decade — that loyalty means everything to us.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler went out on a Friday evening — called Keighley at 6pm and they were here by 8. Turned out to be a faulty diverter valve. Cost a fraction of what another company quoted. Brilliant service, will use them again.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a radiator leak that was soaking through to the living room below. The lad came round same morning, isolated the leak, installed a new rad, and cleaned up. Professional and fair pricing. Can't ask for more.
reviews.author: Susan B.

reviews.text: Asked them to do a full central heating service before winter. They spent time checking all the pipework, bled the system properly, and flushed the boiler. Heating is noticeably quieter now. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David L.
